data_engineer.en: Co-author | OntoTab (GBM): Executed empirical benchmark experiments under 5×3 nested cross-validation across 30,000 public credit-risk records (UCI Taiwan), evaluating ontology-enriched text descriptions encoded via frozen BGE-M3 (1,024 dims) across Logistic Regression, XGBoost, and MLP; with XGBoost, text-only ontology representations (R5) reached 0.5069 AP versus 0.5596 AP for the engineered numeric baseline (R8) and 0.5568 AP for the hybrid model (R9), motivating a separate structured numeric channel.
data_engineer.es: Coautor | OntoTab (GBM): Ejecuté experimentos empíricos bajo validación cruzada anidada (5×3 nested CV) sobre 30,000 registros públicos de crédito (UCI Taiwan), evaluando descripciones enriquecidas con ontologías codificadas mediante BGE-M3 congelado (1,024 dims) en Regresión Logística, XGBoost y MLP; en XGBoost, el brazo de texto con ontología (R5) alcanzó 0.5069 AP frente a 0.5596 AP del baseline numérico estructurado (R8) y 0.5568 AP en el modelo híbrido (R9), demostrando la importancia de preservar canales numéricos tipados.

ai_agentic_swe.en: Led baseline machine learning experiments (Activity E01) over 30,000 credit records (UCI Taiwan, 22.12% default rate) across Logistic Regression, XGBoost, and MLP using 5x3 stratified nested cross-validation and 2,000 bootstrap iterations; evaluated frozen BGE-M3 embeddings vs tabular features, proving structured numeric channels achieve 0.5596 AP (+12.2% over Logistic Regression).
ai_agentic_swe.es: Lideré los experimentos de línea base (Actividad E01) sobre un benchmark de 30,000 registros crediticios (UCI Taiwán, 22.12% default) evaluando Regresión Logística, XGBoost y MLP bajo validación cruzada anidada 5x3 y 2,000 iteraciones bootstrap pareadas vía CLI, demostrando 0.5596 AP en XGBoost.

data_engineer.target_market: Puestos de Junior Data Engineer, Cloud Data Engineer, ETL Developer ($1,500 – $2,500 USD/mes)
approved_bullets_en: Co-designed enterprise near-real-time ELT pipeline on Google Cloud (BigQuery, Dataform SQLX, Datastream CDC, Cloud Storage, HA VPN, Cloud Router) delivering dimensional Lucidchart models and snake_case DDL SQL scripts meeting 100% of client specs.

Developed, parameterized, and tested 15 enterprise ETL jobs in IBM InfoSphere DataStage (Transformers, Lookups, Joins, Merge, Funnel) with zero data loss, querying and configuring IBM DB2 LUW instances on Linux RHEL.

Established auditable cloud governance and FinOps budget validation for client proposals by co-authoring GCP security frameworks (least-privilege IAM, Service Accounts, audit logging, data lineage) and modeling costs in Google Cloud Pricing Calculator.

Architected cloud-native Medallion Lakehouse (Bronze/Silver/Gold) on Google BigQuery orchestrated via Dataform SQLX, transforming 7 raw landing tables into curated Silver views with automated assertions and 3 Gold Star Schema marts.

Engineered decoupled OLTP-to-OLAP streaming pipeline achieving <50 ms edge latency into BigQuery Bronze via REST APIs, enforcing strict ACID concurrency constraints while maintaining a permanent $0.00/mo GCP architecture via Cloud Run scale-to-zero.
approved_bullets_es: Co-diseñó arquitectura de modernización ELT casi en tiempo real en GCP (BigQuery, Dataform SQLX, Datastream CDC, Cloud Storage, HA VPN) entregando modelos dimensionales en Lucidchart y scripts DDL SQL en snake_case al 100% de especificaciones.

Desarrolló, parametrizó y validó 15 jobs de integración ETL en IBM InfoSphere DataStage (Transformers, Lookups, Joins, Merge, Funnel) con cero pérdida de datos, consultando y configurando instancias IBM DB2 LUW sobre Linux RHEL.

Estableció gobernanza cloud y validación FinOps para propuestas de clientes co-diseñando marcos de seguridad GCP (IAM de mínimo privilegio, Service Accounts, auditoría, linaje) y modelando costos en Google Cloud Pricing Calculator.

Diseñó Lakehouse Medallion Cloud-Native (Bronze/Silver/Gold) en Google BigQuery orquestado con Dataform SQLX, transformando tablas crudas en vistas Silver con aserciones automatizadas de calidad y 3 data marts en Star Schema.

Implementó pipeline desacoplado OLTP-a-OLAP con latencia <50 ms hacia BigQuery Bronze vía APIs REST, garantizando transacciones ACID y arquitectura FinOps permanente de $0.00/mes en GCP mediante Cloud Run scale-to-zero.

data_analyst.target_role: Junior / Intern Data Analyst & Analytics Engineer
data_analyst.target_market: Junior Data Analyst, Analytics Engineer, BI Engineer ($1,500 – $2,200 USD/mes)
approved_bullets_en: Formulated functional data contracts under Spec-Driven Development (SDD) for 80/20 Pareto ABC inventory segmentation, Daily Burn Rate, and Days of Inventory (DOI) with 15-day safety buffers, executing analytical SQL window functions to power a 3-page Looker Studio executive dashboard.

Configured automated data quality assertion suites in Google Dataform (SQLX) enforcing primary key uniqueness, referential integrity, and non-null constraints across Silver layers prior to analytical mart aggregation.

Evaluated predictive risk patterns across 30,000 credit records, computing seed-averaged out-of-fold probability distributions and Average Precision (0.5596 AP on XGBoost) using 5x3 nested cross-validation and paired bootstrap confidence intervals.

Transformed client operational data into dimensional warehouse schemas, producing clean entity-relationship models in Lucidchart and validating data completeness across 15 enterprise ETL pipelines with zero loss.
approved_bullets_es: Diseñó contratos de datos analíticos para clasificación Pareto ABC 80/20, Burn Rate diario y Días de Inventario (DOI) con buffer de seguridad de 15 días, implementando Window Functions en SQL para alimentar un dashboard de 3 páginas en Looker Studio.

Configuró suites automatizadas de aserciones de calidad en Google Dataform (SQLX) validando unicidad de claves primarias, integridad referencial y restricciones no nulas en capas Silver antes de la agregación de marts.

Analizó patrones predictivos de riesgo sobre 30,000 registros crediticios, calculando distribuciones de probabilidad out-of-fold y Average Precision (0.5596 AP en XGBoost) bajo validación anidada 5x3 e intervalos bootstrap pareados.
Modeló datos operacionales en esquemas dimensionales de data warehouse en Lucidchart y validó completitud de datos a lo largo de 15 pipelines ETL empresariales con cero pérdida.

ai_agentic_swe.target_role: Junior / Trainee AI & Agentic Software Engineer
ai_agentic_swe.target_market: Trainee Agentic Software Engineer (Ravn Nerdery Program), Junior Python/AI Engineer ($1,200 – $1,800+ USD/mes)
approved_bullets_en: Led baseline machine learning experiments (Activity E01) over 30,000 credit records (UCI Taiwan) using 5x3 stratified nested cross-validation and 2,000 bootstrap iterations; evaluated frozen BGE-M3 embeddings vs tabular features, proving structured numeric channels achieve 0.5596 AP (+12.2% over Logistic Regression).

Built a Python CLI automation tool under Spec-Driven Development (SDD), accelerating corporate technical documentation compile time by 80% and resolving 24+ Azure DevOps engineering tickets while mentoring peers on Git/SSH workflows.

Engineered modular PyTorch (nn.Module) and Excel implementation of Mini-Qwen3 Transformer (RMSNorm, QK-Norm, RoPE, causal attention, SwiGLU) with automated regression tests verifying exact mathematical parity.

Architected and built full-stack SQL evaluation platform (React 19, Monaco Editor, Express, MySQL 8) featuring an in-memory execution mutex serializing sandbox resets, lexical AST parser blocking SQL injection, and a 136-test regression suite.
approved_bullets_es: Lideró experimentos de línea base (Actividad E01) sobre 30,000 registros de crédito (UCI Taiwán) con validación anidada 5x3 y 2,000 bootstraps; evaluó embeddings congelados de BGE-M3 frente a variables tabulares, demostrando que canales numéricos alcanzan 0.5596 AP (+12.2% sobre Regresión Logística).

Desarrolló herramienta CLI en Python bajo Spec-Driven Development (SDD), acelerando compilación de documentación técnica en un 80% y resolviendo 24+ tickets en Azure DevOps mientras capacitaba al equipo en Git/SSH.

Implementó arquitectura modular de Mini-Qwen3 Transformer en PyTorch (nn.Module) y Excel (RMSNorm, QK-Norm, RoPE, causal attention, SwiGLU) con tests de regresión verificando paridad matemática exacta.

Arquitectó y construyó plataforma full-stack de evaluación SQL (React 19, Monaco Editor, Express, MySQL 8) con mutex en memoria para serializar reinicios de sandbox, parser léxico AST anti-inyecciones y suite de 136 tests de regresión.

evidence_gap_catalog.claim_text: EF SET 95/100 in draft recommendation letters and initial profile drafts
evidence_gap_catalog.observed_discrepancy: Draft letter states 'EF SET 95/100'; official certificate cert.efset.org/93nXaa certifies 66/100 overall (Listening 75 C2, Speaking 69 C1, Reading 67 C1, Writing 51 B2).
evidence_gap_catalog.remediation_action: Strictly replace all occurrences of 95/100 with '66/100 (C1 Advanced, Listening C2 75/100)' and enforce linter rule FORBID-EF-001.

evidence_gap_catalog.claim_text: Supervisor contact info in recommendation letter drafts
evidence_gap_catalog.observed_discrepancy: Lines 11-14 contain unpopulated placeholder brackets [Team Lead / Supervisor Name], [+503 XXXX-XXXX].
evidence_gap_catalog.remediation_action: Populate placeholders with Joaquín Francisco Solórzano Corea (AI Team Lead, jsolorzano@gbm.net) or Juan Carlos Quintero Escobar (PO Data & AI) and obtain formal signatures before distributing as certified references.
evidence_gap_catalog.automated_verification_script: python -c "import docx, re; doc=docx.Document('recommendations/en/Recommendation_Letter_Diego_Escobar_EN.docx'); assert bool(re.findall(r'\[.*?\]', ' '.join([p.text for p in doc.paragraphs])))"

evidence_gap_catalog.observed_discrepancy: OntoTab is an internal research paper at GBM authorized for application sharing by PO Joaquín Solórzano, but not peer-reviewed in IEEE/ACM.
evidence_gap_catalog.remediation_action: Enforce framing as 'Co-author (2nd of 7) in empirical credit risk research at GBM' and Activity E01 baseline; block claims of peer-reviewed journal publication via FORBID-ONTO-003.
evidence_gap_catalog.automated_verification_script: python -c "import pypdf; r=pypdf.PdfReader('research/ontotab/OntoTab-finaledit.pdf'); assert 'Diego Alejandro Escobar Barahona 2' in r.pages[0].extract_text()"
